item.title: Judge clears the way for Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order for now
item.description: A federal judge in Boston canceled a nationwide ruling that blocked U.S. Postal Service work on President Trump's order to limit mail-in voting for the midterm election. But a new block may come soon.

item.title: Greetings from Karbala, Iraq, where millions gathered for a Shia pilgrimage
item.description: Pilgrims came to Iraq from all over the world in August. Many Iraqi and Iranian pilgrims walked hundreds of miles in extreme heat to mark the event. Outside the shrines, the atmosphere is almost festive.

item.title: Will Trump's latest beef plan make your hamburger cheaper? Not much, experts say
item.description: The proposal comes weeks before the midterm elections, when food prices and the cost of living are expected to be major issues on voters' minds.

item.title: California says states, Meta agree to $17 billion settlement in child safety trial
item.description: The social media giant also agreed to make sweeping changes to Instagram and Facebook.
